name: Exhausted_1
short_caption: The robot sighs, dropping its head and torso forward in a look of exhaustion before slowly recovering.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and briefly pulls its hands slightly inward towards its hips. It then drops its head and upper body forward in a limp, slumped posture, with its eyes looking downward to convey fatigue. After holding this exhausted pose for a few seconds, it slowly lifts its head and straightens its torso back to the upright neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot droops forward slightly; ensure no physical obstructions are directly in front of its chest/head area.
